items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: So she made an appointment for me with Leon Rene and I went down to his home and he heard, you know, some of the things that I was doing

ctx.x: Augusta Glover, yes. And she said that she was a very dear friend to Leon Rene's wife, the Renes, both of them, for that matter. They happened to have been neighbors and friends, and she suggested, she said, 'I want you to meet Mr. Rene.' she said, 'and I think he can help you.' And she went raving about -- well, I had known of their reputation, you know, and she said, 'I'm going to call him and ask him if he would listen to some of your songs.' Well, I -- you know, she knew that I wrote songs, you know, and she…

So she made an appointment for me with Leon Rene and I went down to his home and he heard, you know, some of the things that I was doing, plus some of the little arrangements that I had done for myself, vocal arrangements, you know. And he wasn't too excited.
